subject: Request: SLA carve-out for content filter / tool-call / structured-output incidents
messages:
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@finbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: FinBank Legal <legal@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SLA carve-out for content filter / tool-call / structured-output incidents

Hi Jordan —

Following last week’s incidents where our integration experienced repeated tool-call failures and structured-output parsing errors tied to the content filter chain, Procurement is requesting a formal carve-out to the standard uptime SLA for filter-related failures while we conduct a joint remediation plan.

Summary: over a 6-hour window on 2026-10-01 the content moderation filter returned intermittent 5xxs and elevated latency (avg 380ms) which triggered tool-call retries and malformed structured outputs. This caused our downstream processing to fall back to a degraded sync path and impacted 18% of requests for certain workflows.

What we need from Redwood:
- A documented exception that acknowledges these incidents can be excluded from the SLA uptime calculation while we run the agreed mitigation (30–60 day window).
- Core evidence: request/response logs, request ids, traces that map filter/tool-call errors to our incidents.
- Proposed compensating controls and timeline (circuit breaker thresholds, fallback behavior, monitoring).

I attached a short SLO exception request form for your legal & reliability teams to review. Please let me know if you need additional context or a short call this week.

Thanks,
Emily Cho
Director, Cloud Procurement
FinBank

Attachment: finbank_slo_request_20261005.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@finbank.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA carve-out for content filter / tool-call / structured-output incidents

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the clear summary and the form. We’re sorry FinBank hit that window of degraded behavior. I’ve looped in reliability and product (cc’d) to triage immediately.

Immediate actions:
- We’ll extract the request ids and traces for the 2026-10-01 window and send a secure bundle by EOD PDT today.
- Reliability will assess whether the root cause is our routing to the third-party filter, our own filter instantiate, or a tool-call orchestration edge case.
- We’ll propose a timeboxed carve-out draft (we typically see 30–45 days for remediation + verification but will confirm).

Can you confirm whether Procurement wants the carve-out to be documented as an amendment to the Order Form or as a temporary service bulletin for operational accounting? That affects the sign-off flow.

I’ll follow up shortly with the logs and a proposed set of exclusion criteria.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SLA carve-out for content filter / tool-call / structured-output incidents

Team — forwarding FinBank’s request and form (attached by Emily). Key points for our response:

Quoted: 
> Following last week’s incidents where our integration experienced repeated tool-call failures and structured-output parsing errors tied to the content filter chain...

Ask: draft a carve-out that covers: (a) content-moderation/filter latency/5xx caused tool-call timeouts, (b) structured-output parsing failures that are downstream of a filter-modified response, and (c) orchestration/toolchain faults where fallback caused measurable degradation.

Proposed approach (please review/comment):
1) Eligibility criteria: incident must show chain of causality (filter response -> tool-call failure OR filter-modified tokens -> structured output parse error). Prefer contiguous traces and request ids.
2) Exclusion window: suggest 45 days from agreement to allow fixes + verification.
3) Mitigations required for exclusion: implement circuit-breaker thresholds (e.g., disable tool-call after 3 consecutive 5xx / 250ms median latency), enable fallback to compatible model variant, and add prefix/KV caching safeguards.
4) Evidence package: request logs (bundle), sampling traces, and an action/remediation plan with milestones at 7/21/45 days.
5) Legal: need an operational bulletin if Procurement wants a temporary accounting exclusion; if they want an Order Form amendment, route to Sales Ops + Legal.

Attachments (I’m preparing): prod-logs-20261004.zip (redacted), incident-schematic.png (sketch).

Please take ownership of sections: Soojin — reliability/mitigations language + thresholds. Karthik — measurement/verification + rollout guardrails. Marissa — pricing/contract flow and whether Sales Ops should convert to amendment.

Thanks — Jordan

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@finbank.com>
Cc: FinBank Legal <legal@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA carve-out for content filter / tool-call / structured-output incidents — Redwood position and next steps

Hi everyone —

Thanks for the patience while we investigated. Summary of our findings and Redwood’s recommended carve-out language below. I’m including Emily and FinBank Legal so the ask and next steps are explicit.

Root cause summary (short): during 2026-10-01 a third-party moderation endpoint exhibited elevated error rates and tail latency which propagated through our tool-call orchestration. In a subset of requests the moderation-modified token stream caused the structured-output parser to fail validation, triggering retries and increased latency. We have identified two distinct failure modes: external filter 5xx/timeout, and internal orchestration retry amplification.

Redwood proposed carve-out (high level):
- Scope: incidents where the primary causal chain is (i) third-party or Redwood-managed content-filter returning 5xx/timeout or high tail latency (>250ms median) AND (ii) resulting tool-call or structured-output validation failure that materially degrades end-user throughput/latency.
- Exclusion period: 45 calendar days from the date both parties sign the operational bulletin or Order Form amendment (whichever Procurement prefers).
- Required mitigations for exclusion to apply:
  * Circuit breaker: disable tool-calls for affected route after 3 consecutive filter 5xxs or median filter latency >250ms across 1-minute window.
  * Fallback path: automatic route to a compatible model variant that does not depend on the failing filter; degrade gracefully rather than blocking.
  * Telemetry: Redwood will provide a logs & traces bundle for every incident and expose a dashboard with request-id sampling for validation.
- Verification: incidents excluded from SLA will be validated against the evidence package. If evidence is inconclusive, the incident will be treated as normal SLA-covered unless mutually agreed otherwise.

Deliverables & timeline:
- Today: provide FinBank with redacted prod logs + incident traces (Jordan sent the bundle).
- +7 days: Redwood deliver mitigation plan + config changes for circuit breaker & fallback (target for staged rollout).
- +21 days: initial staged rollout of fallback with canary traffic and extra tracing.
- +45 days: verification window closes; we will jointly review samples to confirm incidents qualify for exclusion.

Contracting options:
- If Procurement needs a formal amendment for accounting, Sales Ops (Marissa) will prepare an Order Form addendum.
- Alternatively, we can sign an operational bulletin (quicker) that both legal teams acknowledge; DocuSign link provided below.

Next steps for FinBank: confirm preferred contracting route (operational bulletin vs amendment) and sign the bulletin if that’s acceptable. Once signed we will begin the staged mitigation and enable the agreed telemetry.

Doc links / attachments: https://redwoodinternal.company/docs/sla-carveout-playbook (draft carve-out language), DocuSign: https://docusign.com/txn/ABC12345

If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute run-through with engineering and FinBank ops tomorrow.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Reliability & Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: prod-logs-20261004.zip (redacted)
